symptom: A microflow used only as a workflow event handler (`on any workflow event microflow …`), a user task's `on created microflow`, a multi-user task's completion microflow, a group-targeting microflow, or from inside a boundary-event path / event sub-process is listed by graph_dead_assets and `show callers` says "(no callers found)" (TestApp: workflow.WorkflowEventHandle, workflow.UserTaskEventHandle). Workflow activity counts miss the same activities.
cause: extractWorkflowFlowRefs and countFlowActivityTypes each had their own recursion over outcome flows only, and the refs walk read only the activity call slots plus MicroflowBasedUserSource; EventHandlers, OnCreated, CompletionCriteria, MicroflowGroupSource, BoundaryEvents[].Flow and EventSubProcesses were never visited.
insight: One traversal for every workflow pass, built on wfnames.SubFlows (the same sub-flow list DESCRIBE's @N addressing uses) plus the workflow-level event sub-processes: a hand-rolled recursion per pass is how three passes drifted. Verified with a full catalog build on a TestApp copy with a control (Microflows.SplitMerge, really unused, stays dead). An unforced `refresh catalog full` on an existing cache kept the old answer — refs only change through a schema bump.
